title: Language of bipartite perfect matchings
statement: The language consists of exactly those Boolean strings $x$ for which there exist a natural number $n$ and an $n\times n$ Boolean matrix $A$ such that $x$ is the encoding of $A$ and the bipartite graph represented by $A$ has a perfect matching.
